procedure: Under a later runtime lease, require a passing focused compiler and named baseline test. Apply exactly one replacement, require compilation, require the named behavior test to fail, restore exact bytes and mode, and require the baseline compiler and test to pass again. No control has compiled or run here.

controls.name: skip-native-authentication
controls.test: native authentication rejects foreign and missing sender IDs and body-supplied authority
controls.assertion: Foreign bg.ping, bg.job and bg.view return undefined, leave the page untouched and retain view revision zero.
baselineAndMutantTestArgv: native authentication rejects foreign and missing sender IDs and body-supplied authority

controls.name: accept-another-account-view
controls.test: views must match build and both account discriminants before publication
controls.assertion: A complete other-account view leaves the current view and publication history unchanged.
baselineAndMutantTestArgv: views must match build and both account discriminants before publication

controls.name: repeat-hello-on-navigation
controls.after:
page.watch("nav", () => { void hello.call("tab.hello", { ...account(), site, build, hidden: false, fresh: false }) })
    const ticket = epoch
controls.test: one page hello waits for trusted PageLink and ignores navigation and visibility changes
controls.assertion: Two real PageLink navigation events still leave exactly one tab.hello.
baselineAndMutantTestArgv: one page hello waits for trusted PageLink and ignores navigation and visibility changes

controls.name: late-hello-overwrites-push
controls.test: a valid pushed view wins over an older pending hello answer
controls.assertion: The received push revision two remains after the delayed hello revision one resolves.
baselineAndMutantTestArgv: a valid pushed view wins over an older pending hello answer

controls.name: retry-uncertain-mutation
controls.after:
const answer = await page.run(invocation)
        if (!answer.ok && answer.reason === "unconfirmed") void page.run(invocation)
controls.test: a timed-out page mutation remains unconfirmed and is never retried
controls.assertion: The page observes one mutation after its timeout and a late success.
baselineAndMutantTestArgv: a timed-out page mutation remains unconfirmed and is never retried

controls.name: leak-runtime-listener
controls.test: PageLink retirement disposes ExtLink without another retirement announcement
controls.assertion: After PageLink retirement only the fixture background hello listener remains.
baselineAndMutantTestArgv: PageLink retirement disposes ExtLink without another retirement announcement
